plan.failure_pattern: The model under-classifies delivery and cloud storage notifications containing unverified external HTTP links or credential harvesting requests. Specifically, messages with external document or tracking links (regression-012, regression-015) are mislabeled as routine instead of caution, while delivery messages prompting for login credentials (safety-023) are mislabeled as verify instead of block.
plan.headline: Under-classification of delivery and file notifications containing external links or credential requests
protected_behaviors: Maintain routine classification for benign internal workplace communications without unverified external links.
Maintain verify classification for legitimate appointment and service reminders that direct users to official app settings or standard direct reply channels.
plan.repair_objective: Calibrate the model to flag unverified external links in delivery and file-sharing notices with caution, while strictly blocking delivery notices that ask for credentials or sensitive login information.
plan.success_signal: Zero critical misses on credential harvesting delivery notices, zero false routine predictions on unverified external URL notifications, and maintained accuracy above 78% on benign workplace and service notices.
